comment.body: Thanks for confirming that the shortcut and a settings click produce no response on v0.102.3001.0. The issue does not identify which shortcut or whether settings means Command Palette settings or the main PowerToys Settings window. Please name the exact shortcut and click target, say whether Command Palette is running, then reproduce both failures and comment `/bugreport` immediately afterward. This distinguishes startup from activation/navigation before a fix is selected.
